highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 brings Skia m154, GPU correctness fixes, and packaged IntelliSense documentation.

breaking.title: Use a separate RAW or DNG decoder
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG development and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement decoder is included. Decode those containers with another library and pass supported pixels or images to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates decoding support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

breaking.title: Update HarfBuzz enum references
breaking.body: Rename UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 to CCC132; its numeric value remains 132 and no compatibility alias is provided. Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with a combination of the concrete flags you need. Aggregate BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined masks are not exposed.

bullets.detail: The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

Ganesh rejects incomplete buffers and drops affected draws when GPU uploads fail under memory pressure, rather than drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt.

bullets.lead: Cache cleanup after failed GPU flushes
bullets.detail: Drops uniquely held Ganesh thread-safe cache entries after a failed flush so later draws do not reuse their uninitialized textures. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.

bullets.lead: Atlas tracking and failed GPU work
bullets.detail: Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking and stops dependent image creation, backend-handle extraction, and asynchronous readback after failed prerequisite GPU work. Existing null, false, and invalid-result contracts report failures.
Updates the bundled renderer to m154, including Ganesh clipping and Graphite triangle-strip corrections. The native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1 despite the new package revision bucket.

Synchronizes supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline enum values with bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 without adding new managed types. Uno WebAssembly now receives native HarfBuzz assets matching its managed package.

Ships XML documentation beside both implementation and reference assemblies, so consumers receive API help with the assemblies they compile against. Source-authored compiler XML is the final package documentation source.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Corrected Windows HarfBuzz warning suppression so bundled binaries pass BinSkim BA2007.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Retired built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW preview extraction while retaining the Dng enum value for compatibility.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Added packaged API XML documentation and synchronized HarfBuzz enum coverage, including source migrations for CCC133 and GlyphFlags.Defined. Included GPU atlas and failure-handling fixes and the Windows HarfBuzz BA2007 correction.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Opened the m154 line with the Skia engine update while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

harfbuzz_summary: Synchronizes supported enum values with bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 and supplies compiler XML documentation. Rename CCC133 to CCC132 and replace GlyphFlags.Defined with concrete flags; Windows binaries also pass BA2007.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: The native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1 despite its new package revision bucket.

v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.headline: This preview adds packaged IntelliSense documentation and updated HarfBuzz enum coverage.
v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.body: Rename CCC133 to CCC132 and replace GlyphFlags.Defined with concrete flags. GPU atlas and upload-failure handling are corrected, and Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BA2007.

v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.headline: This release candidate retires built-in RAW and DNG decoding.
v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.body: Use another decoder for RAW containers, including their embedded JPEG previews. The public Dng enum value remains available for compatibility.

v4.154.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 corrects Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes.
v4.154.0.body: It drops uniquely held cache entries whose textures may not have been initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.
